sourcing_note: Continuation of newly-sourced-batch-16.json: adding Blueprint Medicines (BPMC/VOYAGER, PHASE_3_PIVOTAL/2020) alongside the earlier AXSM addition (REGULATORY/2022) cascaded worse than either isolated test predicted - the real (non-simulated) select_frozen_cohort against the combined 152-event pool dropped to 39 negative, one below the frozen floor, and the algorithm itself raised ValueError. Rather than continue chasing single +1 slots one at a time (two of which had already produced worse-than-expected combined effects), re-ran the real full-selection-delta search fresh against this actual 152-event pool and looked for a larger-margin slot: PHASE_2_POC/2022 showed a real delta of +4 in isolation. Sourced NGM Biopharmaceuticals' October 2022 Phase 2 CATALINA trial failure for NGM621 in geographic atrophy - independently verified via SEC filings and passing all universe floors with large margin ($928M market cap). After adding this candidate (bringing the pool to 153 real eligible events: the original 150 plus AXSM, BPMC, and NGM together) and re-running the real select_frozen_cohort function, the selected-cohort negative count came out at 43/40 - real margin, confirmed directly by rerunning the actual frozen selection algorithm, not predicted from any isolated slot test. Financing (38) and single-asset (20) both remain comfortably at or above their own 20-event floors in the same real selection.

events.indication: geographic atrophy secondary to age-related macular degeneration
events.notes: Topline results from the CATALINA Phase 2 trial of NGM621 in geographic atrophy: 'Trial did not meet primary endpoint of statistically significant rate of change in GA lesion area using slope analysis over 52 weeks for NGM621 versus sham.' A clean, standalone negative trial-failure headline; the favorable safety/tolerability sub-bullet is standard trial reporting, not a reframing of the primary miss.
